matchingEntries: {folder:"20261013-14",name:"Sprocket Snap",area:"game",desc:"A mobile-first lane-matching arcade game for phones. Tap chunky sprocket lanes to cycle gear colors, match falling bolts in the snap zone, build combo score, unlock the Chrome workshop at 1200 points, and chase your saved best score offline."}

{folder:"20261002-4",name:"Sprocket Splice",area:"game",desc:"A mobile-first gear routing puzzle for phones. Tap chunky sprockets to rotate a spark path from the left socket to the cache, avoid storm gears, bank clean splices for combo score, unlock the brass workshop at 1400 points, and chase your saved best score offline."}

{folder:"20260901-13",name:"Magnet Mender",area:"game",desc:"A portrait-first polarity repair puzzle for phones. Tap chunky magnet tiles to match every glowing socket symbol before the charge drains, chain combo seals, unlock the Aurora workshop at 1800 points, and chase your saved best score offline."}

{folder:"20260813-13",name:"Patch Pop Workshop",area:"game",desc:"A portrait-first quilt packing puzzle for phones. Tap roomy fabric squares to place and rotate chunky patch shapes, pop full rows and columns for combo points, unlock dusk fabric at 1200 points, and chase your saved best score offline."}

{folder:"20260813-5",name:"Tumbler Taps",area:"game",desc:"A portrait-first lock pin arcade game for phones. Tap or hold five large tumblers into their green bands, turn the lock before time drains, build accuracy combos, unlock brass workshop mode at 1800 points, and chase your saved best score offline."}

{folder:"20260527-5",name:"BriefingRoom",area:"saas",desc:"A professional meeting brief management SaaS for teams and meeting leaders. Features structured brief creation with sections (Objectives/Agenda/Decisions/Action Items), 8 meeting types (1-on-1/Team Sync/Project Review/Brainstorm/Retrospective), timed agenda items with owner and duration tracking, attendee management with color-coded avatars, brief pinning and duplication, one-click text export, dashboard analytics with total/weekly briefs stats, search and filter by meeting type, and 100% localStorage persistence. Pre-seeded with 5 team members."}

{folder:"20260512-13",name:"The Empathy Paragraph",area:"learning",desc:"A guided writing tool that helps students practice explaining topics to a complete beginner. Features real-time jargon detection, readability scoring, sentence complexity analysis, and a beginner check mode to develop clear communication skills."}

{folder:"20260507-23",name:"Concept Drift Detector",area:"education",desc:"Paste any text and see if your writing stays on topic. Analyzes paragraphs against an anchor using keyword frequency, visualizes coherence as color-coded bars, and flags paragraphs that drift away from the main topic."}

{folder:"20260506-2",name:"Concept Constellation",area:"education",desc:"A spatial learning tool where you type in topics and they auto-arrange by semantic similarity. Drag, connect with lines, add notes, and generate a learning path through your constellation."}
